last_comment.author: kemppelinvestments-del
last_comment.text:
A second data point for the dispute layer, from the escrow side rather than the notary side. We run a testnet reference (Base Sepolia only, test USDC, early) where payment doesn't go to the seller at settlement: it goes into an escrow contract and is released on a staked evaluator's verdict. If the verdict is "not delivered", or nobody rules before the deadline, the buyer is refunded; a challenged verdict that gets overturned slashes the evaluator's stake. The seller is paid only after a third party says it was delivered.
